title: Total RNA Isolation from Oyster Tissue Using RNAzol RT
author: Sam White

steps.title: Prepare pestle tubes
steps.instruction: Aliquot 500uL of RNAzol RT (Molecular Research Center, Inc. Catalog #RN 190) to pestle tubes and store on ice.

steps.title: Add tissue and RNAzol RT
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue to the pestle tubes containing RNAzol RT and immediately add an additional 500uL of RNAzol RT (Molecular Research Center, Inc. Catalog #RN 190).

steps.title: Homogenize and incubate
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture for 15s and then incubate at room temperature (RT) for 15mins.

steps.title: Centrifuge sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 12,000g for 15mins at RT.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 750uL of the supernatant to a sterile 1.7mL snap-cap tube without disturbing the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Discard remaining liquid in an RNAzol RT Hazardous Waste container in a fume hood.
Leave the old tube open in the fume hood overnight before discarding in regular trash.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume of isopropanol to the supernatant, vortex for 5s, and incubate at RT for 15mins.

steps.title: Recover RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000g for 10mins at RT, then discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Wash RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Add 400uL of 75% ethanol and centrifuge at 4,000g for 3mins at RT.
